meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Reviewed exact HTTP cycle fixture, shared browser timeout, provider budgets and synthetic outcome fixtures against current source.

auth.review_note: Canonical configured username or email matches only the existing owner identity, still requiring password_verify. No credential changes or default password introduced.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed backend skill and commerce data contracts; read-only model-selected facts do not change payment, order, catalogue or checkout writes.

content.review_note: Reviewed browser snapshot bounds, per-owner and page key, revision conflict, explicit save token cleanup and unchanged MySQL CAS and publication status.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed encrypted credential storage merge, blank input preservation, provider order and scoped identity matching; no live schema migration.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed saved AI key labels and blank replacement fields; OAuth reporting grants, analytics and Google tags untouched.

http-errors.review_note: Reviewed shared request failure docs and backend skill; unavailable inference is an explicit saved agent error; HTTP boundary handler unchanged.

interface.review_note: Reviewed write-only API-key fields and safe final-four-character status; masked input rejected and browser tests exercise saved values.

mail.review_note: Reviewed configured username authentication and unchanged login-notification behavior; no mail writes during production diagnostics.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reviewed masked-key handling and provider config; no MCP permissions, protocol or business operations changed.

media.review_note: Reviewed upload eligibility, revision hash, bounded UTF-8 metadata, row lock, exact patch, no row creation, and view/search/isolated DB tests.

operator-help.review_note: Reviewed configured owner identity matching and saved-key status. Existing credentials, explicit help and role checks preserved.

public-mcp.review_note: Verified existing public catalogue framing and published knowledge isolation; normalize UTF-8 media URLs before parsing while retaining safe path validation.

remote-commerce.review_note: Reviewed shared login/configuration changes; existing payment, order and cart operations unchanged.

sales-channels.review_note: Reviewed MediaService metadata/search patch; URL, binary and usage fields used by published feeds remain unchanged.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed binding agent retry instructions, README and generated source maps; existing release gates unchanged.
